description: Publish a jovie.view.v1 JSON spec (stat, sparkline, table, text and sandboxed html blocks) and print the share link that opens it in the dashboard. Needs JOVIE_OVIE_TOKEN in the environment. Pass --id to publish a new version of an existing view.

file.description: Path to a JSON spec file (CLI only)

id.description: Existing view id to publish a new version

name: publish_view
